title: Pre-trained Recommender Systems: A Causal Debiasing Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Modeled as an explicit causal confounder based on item interaction counts, traffic volume, and time. It is mitigated by inferring and removing the popularity bias during inference using do-calculus, and evaluated via ablation studies on recommendation performance metrics (Recall@K%, r-NDCG@K%).

Modeled as a learnable latent implicit confounder representing unique domain properties, such as cultural differences in user communities and promotional campaigns across different countries/markets. Evaluated by applying causal intervention to neutralize this bias during zero-shot and fine-tuned recommendation tasks across cross-market (e.g., India, Spain, Japan) and cross-platform datasets.
